# Tools reference

163 tools, generated from the running server: 114 read-only, 24 writes, 25 destructive-capable (edits, deletions and overwriting filesystem exports; confirmation only where documented). Tool names, parameters and descriptions follow [Taxuspt/garmin_mcp](https://github.com/Taxuspt/garmin_mcp), so clients written for it keep working.

Every result ends with a provenance line: served from the mirror (and when it was fetched), fetched from Garmin just now, or stale and why. Bounded JSON results also carry structured data. See [how sync works](../sync.md#freshness).

Read `garmin://usage` for resource URI examples, prompt names and API costs, including in clients without template discovery. See [MCP context and API budget](context.md). Local-only tools cost no Garmin requests; cache-first tools may fetch missing/stale data, and ranges, pagination, batches and write refetches multiply that cost. General upstream quota is unknown; check timestamped local status and respect cooldowns. Never blindly replay an ambiguous write. Hints describe behavior, not authorization or spending caps.

## The mirror

SQL, catalog and sync status of the local mirror. No Garmin request, ever.

### `garmin_query`

*read*. Run a read-only DuckDB SQL query against the local mirror of the user's Garmin Connect data. Costs no Garmin requests. Use garmin_schema first to see the tables.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `sql` | string | yes |
| `max_rows` | integer, default `200` | no |

### `garmin_schema`

*read*. List the mirror's tables and views with their descriptions and estimated row counts, or, given a table name, its columns with types, units and descriptions. Use before garmin_query.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `table` | string or null | no |

### `garmin_sync_status`

*read*. How complete and fresh the local mirror of Garmin Connect is: coverage per dataset, the sync queue by kind, last run of each periodic task, recent errors, pacing and backoff state, the archive reload quota, the login state, and any fields Garmin returns that the schema does not yet map.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=false`.

## Activity analysis

Analyses computed from the decoded FIT files in the mirror, and file exports.

### `get_activity_fit_messages`

*read*. Retrieve and generically parse an activity's original FIT file (the source of truth for device data): every message and field the FIT decoder emits, in file order, without sport-specific curation. Service-side Garmin Connect edits are not merged.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | integer or string | yes |
| `message_types` | array or null | no |
| `include_records` | boolean, default `False` | no |
| `message_offset` | integer, default `0` | no |
| `message_limit` | integer, default `1000` | no |

### `get_activity_fit_data`

*read*. Analyse an activity's original FIT file (from the mirror's decoded tables) for data the REST API lacks: Di2/eTap shift events with cadence, grade and gear at each shift and shift quality (proactive 70-100 rpm, reactive <70, coasting 0, spun_out >100); cycling dynamics per session and lap (PCO, left/right balance, torque effectiveness, pedal smoothness); variability index; climb detection with VAM and W/kg (latest weigh-in up to 90 days before the ride); grade-correlated power/cadence/HR (grade from the device when present, else derived from altitude and distance; grade_source says which); HR drift for rides of 60 min or more; temperature correlation; the power duration curve (5s to 60min); HRV from RR intervals; optional full per-second records. Multisport files report every leg in sessions and analyse the cycling or longest leg.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | integer or string | yes |
| `include_records` | boolean, default `False` | no |

### `get_power_duration_curve`

*read*. Get the season-best Power Duration Curve across recent activities of a type: best mean maximal power at 5s, 30s, 1min, 5min, 10min, 20min and 60min with the activity and date each best came from, computed from the mirror's FIT records (activities whose file is not mirrored yet are fetched first). Use the 20-minute best x 0.95 as an FTP estimate.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `num_activities` | integer, default `20` | no |
| `activity_type` | string, default `cycling` | no |

### `download_activity_file`

*destructive*. Download an activity and save it to disk: the original .fit (cache-first; a missing FIT may be fetched), or gpx, tcx, csv exports fetched from Garmin. Directory: output_dir, else GARMIN_FIT_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else the persisted set_fit_download_dir; with none configured returns status "needs_setup". Files are named {activity_id}.{ext} and overwrite existing ones. Protected mirror/token/config destinations and symlink traversal are rejected.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `activity_id` | integer or string | yes |
| `format` | string, default `fit` | no |
| `output_dir` | string or null | no |

### `set_fit_download_dir`

*destructive*. Set and persist the default directory for downloaded activity files (in ~/.garminconnect_fit_config.json, overridable via GARMIN_FIT_CONFIG).

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=true, openWorld=false`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |

|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string or null | no |

### `request_reload`

*write*. Request restoration of one archived intraday day. Uses one archive-reload allowance (local conservative limit 25/24h, not an authoritative general Garmin quota); follow-up reads run in about three hours. Check garmin_sync_status first. Ambiguous outcomes are recorded and never automatically replayed; inspect coverage before any manual recovery.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | yes |

### `get_training_load_trend`

*read*. Get Garmin's daily acute and chronic training load over a date range.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string | yes |
| `end_date` | string | yes |

### `get_training_load_balance`

*read*. Get Garmin's Load Focus: the distribution of the trailing-month training load across Aerobic Low, Aerobic High and Anaerobic bands with Garmin's target ranges, a status of below/within/above per band, and the feedback phrase (e.g. AEROBIC_HIGH_SHORTAGE, BALANCED). load_device_id/load_device_name say which device the numbers came from.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | yes |

### `get_hrv_trend`

*read*. Get HRV (Heart Rate Variability) trend over a date range: daily values and the period average. A drop of >10ms from the 7-day baseline warrants reducing training load. Recommended range: 7-21 days. Maximum: 30 days.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string | yes |
| `end_date` | string | yes |

### `get_vo2max_trend`

*read*. Get VO2 max trend over a date range (Garmin's FirstBeat estimates). Days between recomputes carry the last known value forward and are marked carried_forward: true, matching Garmin Connect's chart. Daily changes of <0.5 are noise; focus on the 4-6 week direction. Recommended range: 4-12 weeks. Maximum: 90 days.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string | yes |
| `end_date` | string | yes |

### `get_respiration_trend`

*read*. Get overnight respiration rate trend over a date range. Elevated resting respiration vs the personal baseline is an early sign of overreaching, illness or poor recovery. Recommended range: 7-21 days. Maximum: 30 days.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string | yes |
| `end_date` | string | yes |

### `get_running_tolerance`

*read*. Get Running Tolerance for a single day: tolerance_km (load capacity), acute_load_km (intensity-adjusted load), distance_km, and load_ratio (acute_load_km / distance_km).

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | yes |

### `get_running_tolerance_trend`

*read*. Get Running Tolerance trend over a date range, per period: tolerance_km, acute_load_km, distance_km and load_ratio. Weekly aggregation (default) gives a compact multi-month view. Maximum: 90 days for daily, 366 for weekly.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string | yes |
| `end_date` | string | yes |
| `aggregation` | string, default `weekly` | no |

### `get_acclimation`

*read*. Get heat and altitude acclimation status for a given date (heat_acclimation_percent 0-100, altitude acclimation in meters, Garmin's trend labels and the previous readings).

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `date` | string | yes |

## Workouts and calendar

Workouts, the training calendar, scheduling, and the workout builders adapted from upstream.

### `get_workouts`

*read*. Get all workouts with curated summary list (count and essential metadata; use get_workout_by_id for segments).

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

### `get_workout_by_id`

*read*. Get detailed information for a specific workout, including segments and step structure.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `workout_id` | integer or string | yes |
| `raw` | boolean, default `False` | no |

### `download_workout`

*read*. Download a workout as a FIT file. The binary cannot be returned through MCP; this confirms the workout is available and reports its size.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `workout_id` | integer | yes |

### `upload_workout`

*write*. Upload a workout from JSON data (creates a new workout in Garmin Connect).

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `workout_data` | object | yes |

### `upload_workouts`

*write*. Upload multiple workouts from JSON data in a single call. Each item uses the same structure and rules as upload_workout. Each workout is handled on its own: a failing one is reported and the rest still upload.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `workouts` | array of object | yes |

### `delete_workout`

*destructive*. Permanently delete a workout from Garmin Connect. Call once with confirm=false (the default) to preview, then with confirm=true.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `workout_id` | integer | yes |
| `confirm` | boolean, default `False` | no |

### `delete_workouts`

*destructive*. Permanently delete several workouts. Call once with confirm=false to preview them, then with confirm=true.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `workout_ids` | array of integer | yes |
| `confirm` | boolean, default `False` | no |

### `get_scheduled_workouts`

*read*. Get scheduled workouts between two dates: workouts on the Garmin Connect calendar with their dates and completion status.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string | yes |
| `end_date` | string | yes |

### `get_garmin_coach_workouts`

*read*. Get the active Garmin Coach plan's workouts for the week containing calendar_date (plan summary plus each scheduled workout; the count includes rest days).

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `calendar_date` | string | yes |

### `get_training_plan_workouts`

*read*. Get the active training plan's workouts for the week containing calendar_date (same data as get_garmin_coach_workouts; pass a workout_uuid to get_workout_by_id for details).

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `calendar_date` | string | yes |

### `schedule_workout`

*write*. Schedule a workout on the Garmin Connect calendar. Idempotent: a workout already scheduled on that date is reported and not duplicated.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `workout_id` | integer | yes |
| `calendar_date` | string | yes |

### `schedule_workouts`

*write*. Schedule multiple workouts in a single call. Each item references an existing workout by workout_id, or provides inline workout_data (upload_workout structure) to upload-and-schedule in one step. Each item is handled on its own.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `schedules` | array of object | yes |

### `reschedule_workout`

*destructive*. Move a scheduled workout to another date in place (same calendar-entry id, no duplicate). scheduled_workout_id is the calendar-entry id from get_scheduled_workouts, not the workout's id.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `scheduled_workout_id` | integer | yes |
| `calendar_date` | string | yes |

### `unschedule_workout`

*destructive*. Remove a scheduled workout from the calendar without deleting the workout template. scheduled_workout_id is the calendar-entry id from get_scheduled_workouts, not the workout's id.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `scheduled_workout_id` | integer | yes |

### `unschedule_workouts`

*destructive*. Remove several scheduled workouts from the calendar in one call (workout templates stay in the library). Each id is a calendar-entry id.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `scheduled_workout_ids` | array of integer | yes |

### `create_walk_run_workout`

*write*. Create a run/walk interval workout (warmup, repeats of run then walk, cooldown) and upload it to Garmin Connect.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |
| `run_seconds` | integer | yes |
| `walk_seconds` | integer | yes |
| `repeats` | integer | yes |
| `warmup_min` | integer | yes |
| `cooldown_min` | integer | yes |
| `hr_zone` | string, default `Z3` | no |

### `create_run_workout`

*write*. Create a continuous run workout (warmup, run, cooldown) targeting a heart-rate zone, or a custom bpm range when hr_min and hr_max are given, and upload it.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |
| `run_seconds` | integer | yes |
| `warmup_min` | integer | yes |
| `cooldown_min` | integer | yes |
| `hr_zone` | string, default `Z3` | no |
| `hr_min` | integer or null | no |
| `hr_max` | integer or null | no |

### `create_run_interval_workout`

*write*. Create a running interval workout (warmup, repeats of work then recovery, cooldown) and upload it. Work and recovery target a zone or, with the *_hr_min/*_hr_max pairs, custom bpm ranges.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |
| `repeats` | integer | yes |
| `rep_seconds` | integer | yes |
| `recovery_seconds` | integer | yes |
| `warmup_min` | integer | yes |
| `cooldown_min` | integer | yes |
| `hr_zone` | string, default `Z4` | no |
| `hr_min` | integer or null | no |
| `hr_max` | integer or null | no |
| `recovery_hr_min` | integer or null | no |
| `recovery_hr_max` | integer or null | no |

### `create_z2_walk_workout`

*write*. Create a walking workout held in a custom heart-rate range (Zone 2 walk) and upload it.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |
| `duration_min` | integer | yes |
| `hr_min` | integer | yes |
| `hr_max` | integer | yes |

### `create_strength_workout`

*write*. Create a strength workout and upload it to Garmin Connect. Each exercise becomes a reps-based step; when sets > 1 it is a repeat group of that many iterations (work + rest per set). The name is kept in the step description and sent as exerciseName, which Garmin retains only when it matches one of its own exercise keys (e.g. "FARMERS_CARRY").

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes |
| `exercises` | array of object | yes |

### `schedule_week`

*write*. Schedule several workouts on their dates in one call. Idempotent: a workout already scheduled on that date is reported and the POST skipped. Each entry is handled on its own.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=false, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `week` | array of object | yes |

### `get_calendar_events`

*read*. Get races and events on the Garmin Connect calendar between two dates (entries the user added or subscribed to, such as upcoming races; not returned by get_scheduled_workouts or get_goals). Each event reports distance in meters when stored, the custom goal time in seconds when set, the local start time, is_race and primary_event (the goal race of an active plan).

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `start_date` | string | yes |
| `end_date` | string | yes |

## Strava sync (optional)

Registered only when `STRAVA_SYNC` is set: Strava activity names onto Garmin, and removal of courses Strava's sync left behind. See [Strava sync](../strava-sync.md).

### `strava_sync_status`

*read*. Status of the Strava sync: its settings, the last run's result (renames, conflicts, course deletions or why they were held), what the ledger links, and its recent actions. No Garmin request.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=false`.

### `strava_sync_plan`

*read*. What the Strava sync would do now, without doing it: the Garmin activities it would rename to their Strava names, the renames it leaves alone because the Garmin name was edited by hand, and which Strava-made courses it keeps (with the starred Strava route each matches and how) or would delete (orphaned: no starred route; or an older duplicate). Re-fetches the course list from Garmin first.

Hints: `readOnly=true, destructive=false, idempotent=true, openWorld=true`.

### `strava_sync_apply`

*destructive*. Run one part of the Strava sync now, past the per-run cap; for courses also when STRAVA_SYNC_COURSES is dry-run. Deleted courses cannot be restored. Call once with confirm=false (the default) for the preview, then with confirm=true.

Hints: `readOnly=false, destructive=true, idempotent=false, openWorld=true`.

| Parameter | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `part` | string | yes |
| `confirm` | boolean, default `False` | no |
